song.title: Morning River
song.author: Ana Lestari & Ben Hart
song.lyrics:
[V1] .D G The morning river runs so clear .A D It sings that daybreak has come near
[C] .G D Rise up, rise up, the light is here Rise up and sing
[V2] ;Softer here .D G The evening lantern glows so warm It keeps us safe from every storm
